$comment: RE's own GovernanceMetrics. Design §5: RE may emit a number only if a
declared GovernanceMetric exists for it, with measurement and target filled
in. Every metric here was already being computed and published undeclared;
this is the declaration catching up with the code, not new measurement.
IDEMPOTENT, unlike the survey-definitions batch. 'Create Governance Metric'
creates one element per document and links nothing, so re-running produces
no duplicate edges — the non-idempotency warning that governs
survey-definitions does NOT apply here. Do not copy its post_heal or its
canary-only-when-missing caution across without checking; they exist for
Link First/Next Process Step, which this batch does not use.
Ordering: after foundations (valid value sets), before or after questions —
it depends on neither. Placed last because nothing else depends on it,
so a failure here cannot cascade.
The canary is the headline metric rather than the first in the file: if
Overall Repository Health exists, the components it averages were created
too, since Dr.Egeria processes a document top to bottom and that one is
last of the five health metrics.
